archetypes.name: dyn-recovery-contract
archetypes.rationale: Review the behavioral split between design foreground probes and implement notification-only recovery.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the changed recovery prose in the two SKILL stubs and shared references. Verify that /design still has a clear non-empty-output foreground probe path and that /implement cannot inherit design sentinel probing. Check that empty-output handling, WAIT semantics, and Monitor/background waiter bans remain unambiguous. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-literal-pins
archetypes.rationale: Review whether harness literal pins match the moved prompt authority.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the updated shell harnesses and their asserted literals. Verify that retargeted checks now point to the correct shared files, negative pins catch the removed empty-notification qualifiers, and no required always-loaded stub token moved only into a lazy-read file. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
